test_title: PYST 40: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the correct meaning of the idiom in **bold** and italics.

I had a __**close shave**__ this morning - my car was hit badly by a bull.

options.text: In a position where one might receive severe criticism
To be carrying a wild look
To request someone to stay calm and not get annoyed

solution:
The correct answer **is A NARROW ESCAPE.*****__Key Points__***** Narrow Escape ***means a situation in which an accident or other unfortunate event is avoided.

**Eg. ***my car was hit badly by a bull

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **OPEN TO CRITICISM* (idiom)*** 

 In a position where one might receive severe criticism

***Eg.** *anything the president does is *open to criticism.*

 
• **WILD AND WOLLY**** *(idiom)***

To be carrying a wild look

***Eg.*** Their residence is totally wild and woolly but all in all I found them to be warm people.

 
• ** HAS A SHORT FUSE *(idiom) ***

To request someone to not get annoyed easily

***Eg. ***Be careful how you talk to the Warehouse Manager; he has a pretty* short fuse​**.***
